intro.title: Memoization Strategy
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Vue app that demonstrates memoization by creating a function to calculate the factorial of a number. You will learn how memoization works as a performance optimization technique that caches the results of expensive function calls to avoid redundant calculations. The main technologies involved are Vue's reactive state with ref, computed properties, and JavaScript functions with closures for caching. By the end, you'll understand how to implement a basic memoization strategy to make your applications faster and more efficient.
intro.usecase: Memoization is essential in Vue applications where expensive computations need to be cached for performance. You'll see this pattern in dashboard components that filter and aggregate large datasets, where recalculating metrics on every render would cause lag. It's also crucial in data visualization components like charts and graphs that process complex datasets, and in search interfaces with real-time filtering across thousands of items. By memoizing these computations, you ensure smooth user interactions while maintaining accurate, up-to-date results.
